blocks.text: What was meant to be a leisure trip to Singapore for Nikko Natividad and his wife, Cielo Mae Eusebio, took a heartbreaking turn after they lost their unborn child due to an ectopic pregnancy. Natividad shared the unfortunate news through his Instagram page on Tuesday, Oct. 13, saying they were unaware that Eusebio was pregnant during their trip. “Pumunta kami ng Singapore para mag celebrate ng birthday ni misis. Sinugod siya sa ER. Hindi namin alam na six weeks na pala siyang pregnant,” he said. “Wala kaming choice kundi paoperahan siya agad agad dito sa SG dahil delikado daw at ectopic […]...
